title: ComboBox popup and typing
scenario: A ComboBox with 500 items, open with 60 hover moves and closed with 20 typed characters; plus a 100-item popup in which every row fits. Embedded host (popup drawn into the view). Proves G3, G11. The history variant starts the first ComboBox with 64 Ki units of text and ends with 128 edits in it, each its own undo step: proves W9.3's text-history gate (G13).
drawCalls: not counted: frame.drawCalls is 0 without the counting wrappers

phases.name: warm
phases.description: nothing changes: the first frames lay out both ComboBoxes

phases.name: open
phases.description: focus the 500-item ComboBox and press F4: its popup opens

phases.name: hover
phases.description: the pointer moves to the centre of popup row (step mod 8)

phases.name: type
phases.description: one character typed into the closed editable ComboBox (popup does not auto-open)

phases.name: fit-open
phases.description: focus the 100-item ComboBox and press F4: its popup opens with every row visible

phases.name: fit-hover
phases.description: the pointer moves to the centre of popup row 5 x step

phases.name: history
phases.description: history variant: the 500-item ComboBox takes focus again and step k makes edit k of 128 at its own place (W9.3); other variants: nothing
